t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each gnome is tied to a different color of basket. When you find out which color of of basket thats most profitable is tied to which gnome, stick with that basket until you see the number start to decrease. That is when you should go after the other color of basket for the most points. Of course keep in mind the x5 is a multiplier also, so there will be more win and lose when you see that.

vb_textbox.text: Each color of gnome is tied to a certain color of basket. The closer that gnome is on the color spectrum to that color, that is the color of basket they will give you. There is a red basket and yellow basket. So for example, if you are shown a purple gnome and blue gnome, the purple gnome will lead you to the red basket as purple is red+blue. If shown a green gnome and brown gnome, the green gnome will lead you to the yellow basket as it is closer to yellow than brown is. Feel out which basket giving you the highest amount by switching your choices up to begin with, comparing the amounts when under the same multiplier. Work out which is higher after a couple of turns and stick with that. When the number starts to fall, try going after the opposite color of basket. Even if your basket has given you a decent amount of mushrooms, every so often try the opposite color just to make sure its not giving you even higher. As you play the game you will get a feel for what is a good amount of mushrooms or not, depending on the multiplier.
